subject: Kickoff: neural-guided symbolic regression as a formula-discovery service
body:
Hi Bruno,

Kickoff for the symbolic regression effort. Base: our open-source release on neural-guided symbolic regression with asymptotic constraints — an expression-generating network that respects a formula's leading power at 0 and at infinity. Training set is 28,837 rational expressions with complexity M <= 4; the release also ships holdout sets at M=5 and M=6 specifically to test generalization beyond training complexity, plus metrics code for success rate, L1-distance, and syntactic/semantic novelty.

Product: data-platforms customers who want closed-form, auditable relationships out of tabular data instead of black-box regressors. Constraint-conditioning is our differentiator — analysts usually know the asymptotics even when they don't know the formula.

Milestones in our short window (04-13 to 06-29): training pipeline reproduced by mid-May, constraint-conditioning eval by mid-June, go/no-go readout 06-25.

Resourcing thoughts?

Dmitri
